Product Description

Coevera: The AI-Native Revenue Platform Built for How Selling Actually Works Today Coevera is the AI-native revenue platform redefining how modern sales organizations operate, collaborate, and grow. Born from more than a decade of CRM innovation as Pipeliner, Coevera represents the next evolution: a purpose-built system designed not to digitize old sales processes, but to reimagine them for an era where AI is a teammate, not a tool. At the heart of Coevera is a simple conviction—traditional CRMs were built for managers to extract data from sellers. Coevera flips that model. It's built for sellers, with AI woven into every workflow to eliminate busywork, surface insight, and accelerate revenue. The result is a platform where reps actually want to log in, managers get the visibility they need without the chase, and leadership gains a real-time understanding of pipeline health, risk, and opportunity. Coevera is powered by \*\*Voyager AI\*\*, an intelligent engine that continuously learns from your sales motion to deliver predictive guidance, contextual recommendations, and automated execution. \*\*The Collaborator\*\* transforms the CRM from a system of record into a system of engagement—a true AI partner that helps sellers prepare for calls, draft communications, navigate complex deals, and stay ahead of every opportunity. The \*\*Automatizer\*\* workflow engine removes the manual friction that drains seller productivity, while native \*\*Model Context Protocol (MCP)\*\* integration ensures Coevera connects seamlessly with the broader AI ecosystem your business already relies on. What truly sets Coevera apart is its commitment to being AI-native, not AI-washed. Unlike legacy platforms that bolt generative features onto decades-old architecture, Coevera was rebuilt from the ground up to make intelligence the default state of the system—not a premium add-on. Every dashboard, pipeline view, and workflow is designed to think alongside you. Coevera also champions visual selling, intuitive navigation, and rapid time-to-value. Implementation is measured in weeks, not quarters. Adoption is high because the experience is built around the seller, not against them. For organizations ready to move beyond the limitations of legacy CRM and embrace a smarter, faster, more human way to sell, Coevera is the platform built for what's next. It's not just a new name—it's a new category. Welcome to AI-native revenue. \*\*Coevera. Sales, evolved.

Product Description

Salesflare is a B2B sales CRM for small and medium-sized businesses that keeps itself up to date automatically. It captures contacts, companies, emails, meetings and relationship data, so sales teams spend less time maintaining their CRM and more time following up with customers. Connect Gmail, Outlook and your calendar, and Salesflare automatically builds complete customer timelines from your team’s interactions. It enriches contact and company records, suggests who and what to follow up on, and keeps your sales pipeline organized without requiring constant manual data entry. Because Salesflare captures customer and relationship data automatically, its AI can work from richer and more up-to-date context. It can help write emails, summarize customer timelines, suggest follow-ups and prepare for meetings. Salesflare also includes visual sales pipelines, automated reminders, email and website tracking, email sequences, lead scoring, relationship intelligence, customizable dashboards, mobile apps, and integrations with the tools sales teams already use. Salesflare is especially suited to relationship-driven B2B sales teams such as agencies, consultancies, software companies and other small and medium-sized businesses that want powerful sales follow-up without the usual CRM administration. Salesflare integrates with Gmail, Outlook, LinkedIn, Zapier, Make and thousands of other business tools. A free trial of up to 30 days is available.

## Pipedrive Alternatives FAQs

Generated using AI

### What are the best alternatives to Pipedrive in 2026?

The best alternatives to Pipedrive based on G2 user reviews include [Nutshell](https://www.g2.com/products/nutshell/reviews) (4.3/5 stars, 1430 reviews), [Freshsales](https://www.g2.com/products/freshsales/reviews) (4.5/5 stars, 1233 reviews), [Copper](https://www.g2.com/products/copper/reviews) (4.5/5 stars, 1157 reviews), [Nimble](https://www.g2.com/products/nimble/reviews) (4.5/5 stars, 1115 reviews), [Agentforce Sales](https://www.g2.com/products/agentforce-sales-formerly-salesforce-sales-cloud/reviews) (4.4/5 stars, 25803 reviews), and [HubSpot Sales Hub](https://www.g2.com/products/hubspot-sales-hub/reviews) (4.4/5 stars, 13814 reviews). These alternatives are favored for their ease of administration, better support, usability, and comprehensive feature sets. Notably, [Freshsales](https://www.g2.com/products/freshsales/reviews) and [Copper](https://www.g2.com/products/copper/reviews) have higher average ratings (4.5/5) compared to Pipedrive's 4.3/5.

### What features do alternatives offer that Pipedrive does not?

Alternatives to Pipedrive offer several features not available natively in Pipedrive, including AI Text Generation (available in Nutshell, Freshsales, Copper, HubSpot Sales Hub, Coevera, and Salesflare), Commission Calculators (Freshsales, Copper, HubSpot Sales Hub, Zoho, Bigin by Zoho CRM, Coevera, and Salesflare), and Partner Relationship Management (PRM) (Freshsales, Agentforce Sales, HubSpot Sales Hub, Zoho, Coevera).

### Which CRM tools do reviewers recommend instead of Pipedrive?

Reviewers recommend CRM tools such as [Nutshell](https://www.g2.com/products/nutshell/reviews), [Freshsales](https://www.g2.com/products/freshsales/reviews), [Copper](https://www.g2.com/products/copper/reviews), [Nimble](https://www.g2.com/products/nimble/reviews), [Agentforce Sales](https://www.g2.com/products/agentforce-sales-formerly-salesforce-sales-cloud/reviews), and [HubSpot Sales Hub](https://www.g2.com/products/hubspot-sales-hub/reviews) as alternatives to Pipedrive. These tools are praised for their ease of use, better support, more comprehensive features, and suitability for various business sizes and sales processes. For example, [Nutshell](https://www.g2.com/products/nutshell/reviews) is highlighted for its all-in-one sales and marketing platform with excellent support, while [Freshsales](https://www.g2.com/products/freshsales/reviews) is noted for its powerful feature set and AI capabilities. [Copper](https://www.g2.com/products/copper/reviews) is recommended for its seamless Google Workspace integration, and [Agentforce Sales](https://www.g2.com/products/agentforce-sales-formerly-salesforce-sales-cloud/reviews) for its AI-driven automation and scalability. [HubSpot Sales Hub](https://www.g2.com/products/hubspot-sales-hub/reviews) is favored for its unified platform and ease of adoption.

### How does Pipedrive compare to Nutshell?

According to G2 data, [Pipedrive](https://www.g2.com/products/pipedrive/reviews) and [Nutshell](https://www.g2.com/products/nutshell/reviews) both hold an average rating of 4.3 out of 5, with Pipedrive having 3,053 reviews and Nutshell 1,430 reviews, indicating strong user bases for both. Pipedrive scores higher in meeting requirements (8.5 vs 8.4), usability (8.8 vs 8.7), and ease of setup (8.7 vs 8.5), while Nutshell leads in ease of administration (8.7 vs 8.6), support (8.7 vs 8.4), and ease of doing business (8.8 vs 8.7), with differences ranging from 0.1 to 0.3 points. Feature-wise, Pipedrive offers advanced capabilities such as account-based analytics, automated email responses, conditional logic, e-commerce integration, sales gamification, social media integration, and surveys, which Nutshell lacks. Conversely, Nutshell provides AI text generation and summarization features not available in Pipedrive. User sentiment highlights Pipedrive's strengths in ease of use (574 mentions), intuitive interface (274 mentions), integrations (210 mentions), and lead management (208 mentions), while common cons include missing features (230 mentions) and a learning curve (118 mentions). Nutshell users praise its ease of use (358 mentions), helpfulness (201 mentions), and customer support (171 mentions), with cons focusing on missing features (168 mentions) and limited customization (79 mentions). Overall, Pipedrive excels in advanced sales and marketing features and integration breadth, making it suitable for users needing robust customization and analytics. Nutshell offers a simpler, user-friendly experience with strong support and AI-assisted text capabilities, appealing to teams valuing ease of use and streamlined workflows.

### Why do users choose Nutshell over Pipedrive?

Users choose [Nutshell](https://www.g2.com/products/nutshell/reviews) over Pipedrive primarily for its user-friendly interface and strong customer support, as reflected by 171 mentions praising support and 358 mentions highlighting ease of use. Nutshell's intuitive design and straightforward setup reduce onboarding time, making it accessible for teams without extensive technical resources. Its AI text generation and summarization features provide practical automation benefits that enhance daily workflows. Nutshell's visual pipeline management and centralized customer information improve organization and visibility, helping users manage sales processes efficiently without complexity. The platform's seamless email integration and automation tools reduce manual tracking, which users find valuable for maintaining consistent communication. Additionally, Nutshell's pricing and included onboarding services offer competitive value for small to mid-sized teams seeking a balance between functionality and simplicity. Users appreciate Nutshell's focus on core CRM needs with less complexity, making it a preferred choice for businesses prioritizing ease of use, quick adoption, and responsive support over extensive feature sets and integrations.
